items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That is the best saxophone section probably that Danny Bank ever played in. ... We had Al Cohn, wonderful band. ... Herbie Steward, Al Cohn, Frankie Socolow, who was playing alto by then I think.

ctx.x: Zoot, yeah that’s right! That is the best saxophone section probably that Danny Bank ever played in. Herbie was playing lead alto, he turned out to be a wonderful alto player.
So we were talking about Artie Shaw’s band, his 1949 band.
